blot.en: A small blot of ink covered part of the handwritten note.
blot.zh: 一小塊墨漬蓋住了手寫筆記的一部分。

bribe.en: The civics class discussed why a bribe can damage public trust.
bribe.zh: 公民課討論了賄賂為何會破壞公共信任。

democrat.en: The textbook defines a democrat as someone who supports democratic government.
democrat.zh: 課本把 democrat 解釋為支持民主政府的人。

hell.en: The novel uses hell as a symbol of fear and punishment.
hell.zh: 這本小說把地獄作為恐懼與懲罰的象徵。

heterosexual.en: The health textbook lists heterosexual as one term describing sexual orientation.
heterosexual.zh: 健康教育課本把 heterosexual 列為描述性傾向的詞之一。

homosexual.en: The glossary explains homosexual as a term related to sexual orientation.
homosexual.zh: 詞彙表把 homosexual 解釋為與性傾向相關的詞。

intimacy.en: Trust and honesty can create emotional intimacy in close friendships.
intimacy.zh: 信任與誠實可以在親近的友誼中建立情感上的親密感。

intimate.en: The memoir gives an intimate view of the artist's daily routine.
intimate.zh: 這本回憶錄深入呈現了這位藝術家的日常生活。

kiss.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting.
kiss.zh: 在某些文化中，親吻臉頰是一種常見的問候方式。

ma’am.en: The student said ma’am politely when answering the guest speaker.
ma’am.zh: 學生回答來賓講者時，禮貌地使用了 ma’am 這個稱呼。

o.k..en: The editor noted that o.k. is an older written form of okay.
o.k..zh: 編輯指出 o.k. 是 okay 較舊的一種書寫形式。

o’clock.en: The museum closes at five o’clock on weekdays during winter.
o’clock.zh: 冬季平日時，博物館下午五點閉館。

odds.en: The odds of drawing a red card are easy to calculate.
odds.zh: 抽到紅色牌的機率很容易計算。

p.m..en: The library closes at 9 p.m. from Monday through Friday.
p.m..zh: 圖書館從星期一到星期五晚上九點關門。

romance.en: The novel mixes mystery with a quiet romance between adult characters.
romance.zh: 這本小說把懸疑元素與成年角色之間平淡的愛情情節結合在一起。

romantic.en: The film uses romantic music to signal a change in mood.
romantic.zh: 這部電影用浪漫的音樂來暗示情緒的轉變。
